codelist.name: Origin HeartGold v1.0.0-rc5 widescreen and camera

cheat.name: 16:9 camera - widescreen ON
cheat.note: Enable only one of these two codes at a time. Set the emulator's top screen to 16:9. The 3D camera switches when it is next created: enable the code before loading your save, or go through a door. Only the 3D view widens; 2D graphics on the top screen stretch.

cheat.name: 4:3 camera - widescreen OFF
cheat.note: Disable the ON code first. Restores the standard 4:3 camera; set the top screen back to 4:3. The camera switches back when it is next created: go through a door or reload your save.

cheat.name: Interiors: real 3D, original framing
cheat.note: Switches the flat (orthographic) interior camera to a real 3D one with the same framing. Outdoor maps and gyms are not touched. Applies after the next door. To undo, disable the code and go through a door. See CAMERA_CHEATS.md.

cheat.name: Interiors: normal outdoor 3D camera
cheat.note: Interiors use the normal outdoor camera (like the US Normal 3D code, but only inside buildings). Applies after the next door. To undo, disable the code and go through a door.

cheat.name: Force preset 00: normal 3D everywhere
cheat.note: Port of the US Normal 3D code. Every map uses the outdoor camera. Enable only one Force or Custom code. Applies after the next door; the preset is stored in the save until the next door after disabling. Edit the last digits of the third line (00 to 10 hex) for any other preset.

cheat.name: Force preset 02: lower angle (Gen 5 style)
cheat.note: Port of the US Slightly lower code. Every map uses a 40 degree camera instead of 49. Enable only one Force or Custom code. Applies after the next door; the preset is stored in the save until the next door after disabling. Edit the last digits of the third line (00 to 10 hex) for any other preset.

cheat.name: Force preset 06: slightly lower, further view
cheat.note: Every map uses a 45 degree camera with more draw distance. Enable only one Force or Custom code. Applies after the next door; the preset is stored in the save until the next door after disabling. Edit the last digits of the third line (00 to 10 hex) for any other preset.

cheat.name: Force preset 09: steeper top-down
cheat.note: Every map uses a 60 degree camera. Enable only one Force or Custom code. Applies after the next door; the preset is stored in the save until the next door after disabling. Edit the last digits of the third line (00 to 10 hex) for any other preset.

cheat.name: Custom camera (template: normal camera)
cheat.note: Copies the normal camera into unused preset 6 and forces it everywhere. Edit the values: distance, tilt, FOV+projection, near, far, look-at shift X/Y/Z. See CAMERA_CHEATS.md for the encoding. Example: tilt 35 degrees = 02205488 0000E71C with far clip 02205498 005DC000. Enable only one Force or Custom code.
